was prepared by arc-melting a mixture of high-purity metals (purity better than 99.9 mass %) in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere. Each ingot was melted at least four times to promote the chemical homogeneity.
Then the ingots were re-melted by induction heating and flip-cast into a copper mold with a dimension of 20×18×80 mm 3.
The as-cast alloy was homogenized at 1200°C for 24 h followed by a water quenching.
The specimens were heated with a rate of 5 °C s -1 and held for 3 mins to obtain a homogenized temperature state.
All the specimens were compressed to ~50% height reduction.
